decisions.reason: The existing Requirement already covers guidance on front and back matter and other publishing needs; clarifying the cover deliverable does not change that guidance obligation.
The cover deliverable decision does not change how chapter illustrations should be reviewed for tone or colour-palette fit.
The source decision concerns the paperback cover and does not modify manuscript wording or editorial-polish expectations.
A complete paperback cover does not alter the aspect-ratio or cropping requirements for chapter images.
The source decision does not change the inclusion, timing, selection, or placement of chapter images.
The paperback cover clarification has no effect on Chapter 12 heading hierarchy, capitalization, or punctuation.
The broad reference to back matter does not change the existing publisher-attribution content or presentation.
The cover decision does not modify which manuscript revision or approved textual edits must be integrated.
In the supplied context, the cover page refers to the externally designed paperback cover, not the interior title page or its title formatting.
